text:
alex: Drafting internal RN + brief for the midnight micro-deploy (runtime v2.3.6). Change window 00:00 PT -> 01:00 PT. Key points: 1) fix for batching stall under high-concurrency, 2) tighten autoscaler cooldown for Dedicated pools, 3) guard against KV cache nil pointer on cold start. Need quick sign-off on RN copy and rollback thresholds.

sam-ops: I'll be primary deployer. Proposed canary flow: 3% -> 20% -> 100% with 12m hold between steps. Health checks: error-rate (<2%), p95 latency (<700ms), SLOs stable. Rollback triggers: error >=2% sustained for 6m OR p95 > 900ms for 10m OR new alerts from svc-metrics. Agree?

mira: Few copy tweaks: change "KV cache nil pointer" to "KV cache NPE on cold start" in RN. Add Known Impact: "Short reconnects for Dedicated customers during instance churn." I'll add the short sentence.

raj: Infra note: we should pin routing to v2.3.5 as fallback for 45m after full rollout (not 30m) so we have breathing room for investigations. Also add runbook link in RN: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy - oncall list: @oncall-runtime, @infra-ops.

sam-ops: Deploy command I'll use (staging smoke green):
```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.3.6 canary=3% step=12m health=svc-metrics-check
```
Manual increments at each step. To abort: `deploybot cancel 1765448888`.

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke passed 22:55 PT. Canary plan loaded: 3% -> 20% -> 100%. To rollback: `deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.3.5 --reason "canary fail"`.

alex: Timing for comms: 23:30 PT staff brief, 23:40 internal announce, 00:00 deploy. Who is cutting the internal brief?

mira: I can cut the brief at 23:30. Will include quick hits + evacuation cue.

raj: Confirming fallback pin: I'll run `routing pin runtime v2.3.5 --duration 45m` if we need to rollback. Also added an infra checklist to the RN doc.

sam-ops: Rollback command saved. Manual rollback will also call the pin command. If we need to do emergency rollback during canary step, I'll run both commands in sequence.

alex: Minor RN microcopy: under "Rollback guidance" add the steps in order: 1) abort increment, 2) run rollback, 3) pin routing, 4) notify customers if >15m outage.

mira: Done. RN updated and linked in the doc.

sam-ops: All good from my side. Starting deploy at 00:00 PT unless someone yells hold. Deploybot will post progress here and ping @oncall-runtime on anomalies. :rocket:

alex: Thanks team. Final ask: everyone confirm rollback thresholds and pin duration (45m). If no objections I'll post the staff brief at 23:30.

raj: Confirmed.

mira: Confirmed.

sam-ops: Confirmed.
alex: Posting staff brief in 15m.
